children: ONEOK entered into a Contribution Agreement with AP Falcon Holdings, an affiliate of Apollo, for a $9 billion cash investment in exchange for Class B units of ONEOK Holdings. In parallel, ONEOK will contribute 100% of ONEOK, L.L.C. to the subsidiary for Class A units. Proceeds are expected to support the Brazos Midland acquisition and repay approximately $5 billion of senior debt. The related operating agreement sets quarterly distribution mechanics, buyout rights, and governance terms.
: Contribution agreement for $9 billion Class B investment
: Fund Brazos Midland acquisition and repay debt
